name: adventurers-chronicle
author: Always
description: New to Ragnarok, or coming back after years and not sure where to go next? The Adventurer's Chronicle is a story-driven main quest that walks you across Rune-Midgard at the right pace for your level: from Prontera's fields at level 1 to Odin's Temple past 99, through Payon, Morroc, Geffen, Glast Heim, Juno, Rachel and Hugel. Its 8 chapters retell Rune-Midgard's own lore: the weakening seals, Geffenia, the fall of Glast Heim, Juperos, The Sign. Hunt, gather and face a named boss in every region; quest EXP carries you to the next quest's level, and each chapter ends with a costume of your choice. A built-in journal (Alt+B) recaps everything you've done and shows what to do next, with a Route link that opens Navigation to the exact spot. Veterans can skip ahead to their level. For travel, pair it with NPC Plus: its Warper can unlock each place as you set foot in it. Friendly to new and veteran players alike. Pre-renewal.
